notes.title: Update Note 2018.06.28 KST
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We want to let you know that we have added an Easy Mode on the newest update.

On the Easy Mode, there won't be any traps available. You will be aided with a crossbow and simply press trigger button to shoot the arrows.

Also, multiplayer is also available on this Easy Mode!

Join with other friends and defeat the Orc!!

Enjoy! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: [Notice] Bug Fixed (partially)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We have fixed the issue where the controllers were not working properly. However for multiplayer mode, there is still a little problem with the modelling/animation. 

We are fixing this issue and will update the game asap.

Thank you for your understanding!!

notes.title: [Notice] Controller Bugs
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We would like let you know that currently, there is a bug that might cause you experience abnormalities while playing the game on some PCs. This bug causes the controllers cannot be used properly. :(

We are trying to find the root issue and fix it as soon as possible.

We are truly apologies for this inconvenience and hope you understand.

Thank you!
